text: This report submits the Toronto Zoo 2022 Operating Plan and Budget for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2022 Operating Plan and Budget on August 25, 2021 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2022 Operating Plan and Budget as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (September 15, 2021) from the Director, Finance and Technology, Toronto Zoo.
